Patched the existing `officeqa-bond-yield-spread-monthly` skill rather than creating a new one — the table location, series-column disambiguation, and retrospective monthly-table layout were already covered there, so this is the natural home.

What I added (generalizable, not per-question trivia):
- The same "Average Yields of Long-Term Bonds" table feeds a Pearson-correlation sibling question type, with the exact procedure.
- The two key traps: (1) each calendar year is its own 12-point correlation — do NOT pool both years into 24 points; (2) it's |r1 − r2| (difference of two correlations), not the correlation of differences.
- "New Aa corporate" is a distinct new-issue column vs seasoned Aa — match the word "New."
- A near-zero answer (0.0003) is legitimate because these nominal-yield series co-move tightly — don't second-guess a tiny result.

No memory update needed; this is procedural and belongs in the skill. Done.
